title: After a Total Knee Replacement — Early Movement, Strength and Safety

hook.en: A knee replacement removes the pain, but the muscles and movement must be rebuilt. Learn the stages of rehab, the goals that matter and the warning signs you must never miss.
hook.ur: Knee replacement dard khatam karti hai, magar muscles aur harkat dobara banani parti hain. Rehab ke marahil, ahem maqasid aur woh warning signs seekhein jo kabhi miss nahi karne.

goal.en: By the end, you'll plan rehab from day one to the return to full activity, set range and strength goals, manage swelling and pain, and recognise infection, a clot or a stiff knee that needs the surgeon.
goal.ur: End tak aap pehle din se poori activity tak rehab ka plan banayenge, range aur taaqat ke maqasid tay karenge, sujan aur dard sambhalenge, aur infection, clot ya akhre hue knee ko pehchanenge jis ke liye surgeon chahiye.

text.en: Rehab starts **on the day of surgery or the day after**, with standing and walking. Early goals are to control **pain and swelling**, regain **full straightening** (extension) and reach **bending** of at least 90 degrees by about two weeks, and wake up the **quadriceps**. Later goals are strength, stairs, balance and getting back to the person's own life. Always follow the **surgeon's protocol**, which differs between units.
text.ur: Rehab **surgery ke din ya agle din** khare hone aur chalne se shuru hoti hai. Shuruati maqasid **dard aur sujan** par qaboo, **poori seedhi hone** (extension) ki wapsi aur takreeban do haftay mein kam az kam 90 degree **mudne** tak pahunchna, aur **quadriceps** ko jagana hain. Baad ke maqasid taaqat, seedhiyan, balance aur shakhs ki apni zindagi mein wapsi hain. Hamesha **surgeon ka protocol** maanein, jo units mein mukhtalif hota hai.

text.en: Think of the new knee as a **new hinge in a door** that is also surrounded by sore, swollen, sleepy muscles. The hinge is perfect, but if the door frame stiffens it will not swing. Early, steady movement keeps the frame loose; strengthening teaches the muscles to hold the door steady again.
text.ur: Naye knee ko **darwaze ka naya kabza** samjhein jo dardnak, soojhe hue, sust muscles se ghira hai. Kabza bilkul theek hai, magar chaukhat akhar jaye to darwaza nahi jhoolega. Shuruati, musalsal harkat chaukhat ko dheela rakhti hai; strengthening muscles ko sikhati hai ke darwaza dobara sthir rakhein.

title.ur: Total knee replacement ke baad rehab

steps.title: Start early and control swelling
steps.detail: Get the person standing and walking with an aid within a day, with pain relief taken before sessions. Use elevation, ice if comfortable and regular movement to control swelling. || Jaldi shuru karein aur sujan par qaboo rakhein

steps.title: Win the extension and bend
steps.detail: Aim for full extension (heel props, quadriceps sets) and bending at least 90 degrees in the first two weeks, building towards 110 to 120 over the next weeks. Stiffness is easier to prevent than to reverse. || Extension aur mudna hasil karein

steps.title: Build the quadriceps
steps.detail: Progress from quadriceps sets and straight leg raises to sit-to-stand, step-ups, bridging and cycling, adding load as strength and comfort allow. Weak quadriceps explain many knees that give way. || Quadriceps mazboot karein

steps.title: Return to life and review
steps.detail: Practise stairs, walking tolerance, getting on and off the floor if needed and the person's own goals (prayer, work, travel). Review at six and twelve weeks, and refer if progress stalls. || Zindagi mein wapsi aur review

text.en: **Straight first, then bend.** A knee that cannot straighten limps and tires the quadriceps; one that cannot bend cannot manage stairs. Work on both from the first week, and quadriceps strength supports both.
text.ur: **Pehle seedha, phir mudna.** Jo knee seedha nahi ho sakta woh langrata hai aur quadriceps ko thakata hai; jo mur nahi sakta woh seedhiyan nahi chadh sakta. Pehle haftay se dono par kaam karein, aur quadriceps ki taaqat dono ko sahara deti hai.

text.en: **Stopping at "good range, good pain".** Pain-free movement does not mean strong. Many patients stop exercising once the pain eases and are left with weak quadriceps. Continue strength training for at least three months, with a clear plan.
text.ur: **"Achhi range, achha dard" par ruk jana.** Dard ke baghair harkat ka matlab taaqatwar nahi. Bohat se mareez dard kam hote hi exercise chhor dete hain aur kamzor quadriceps reh jate hain. Kam az kam teen mahine saaf plan ke saath strength training jaari rakhein.

question.en: Which finding after a knee replacement needs urgent review?
question.ur: Knee replacement ke baad kaun si finding foran review maangti hai?

text.en: A hot, red, swollen knee with fever or a wound that is leaking

feedback.en: Yes — these suggest infection and need the surgical team at once.
feedback.ur: Haan — yeh infection ki nishaniyan hain aur surgical team ko foran chahiye.

text.en: Muscle ache the day after exercise
text.ur: Exercise ke agle din muscle dard

text.en: Mild swelling that goes down with rest and elevation
text.ur: Halki sujan jo aaram aur oonchai se kam ho

question.en: A calf that is hot, tender and swollen after surgery may mean what?
question.ur: Surgery ke baad pindli garam, dardnak aur soojhi ho to iska kya matlab ho sakta hai?

feedback.en: It has nothing to do with strength.
feedback.ur: Is ka taaqat se koi talluq nahi.

text.en: A deep vein thrombosis, which needs urgent medical assessment
text.ur: Deep vein thrombosis, jis ke liye foran medical assessment chahiye

feedback.en: Yes — do not massage or exercise the leg; seek urgent assessment.
feedback.ur: Haan — taang ki malish ya exercise na karein; foran assessment karwayein.

feedback.en: A hot, tender calf is not a normal sign.
feedback.ur: Garam, dardnak pindli normal nishani nahi.

text.en: **Teach the plan, not only the exercises.** Give the person clear goals for each week, a list of warning signs and who to call. Help them manage pain so they can exercise, set a step goal and celebrate milestones, such as the first full stair climb.
text.ur: **Sirf exercises nahi, plan sikhayein.** Shakhs ko har haftay ke saaf maqasid, warning signs ki fehrist aur kis ko call karna hai dein. Dard sambhalne mein madad karein taake woh exercise kar sake, qadmon ka maqsad tay karein aur sang-e-meel manayein, maslan pehli baar poori seedhiyan chadhna.

question.en: Why does a stiff knee after replacement need action early?
question.ur: Replacement ke baad akhra hua knee mein jaldi kaarwai kyun zaroori hai?

answer.en: Scar tissue forms and matures in the first weeks, so lost range is much harder to regain later. If bending does not progress as expected, tell the surgical team early, as they may advise stronger pain control, more intensive therapy or a manipulation under anaesthetic.
answer.ur: Pehle haftay mein scar tissue banta aur pukhta hota hai, is liye khoyi hui range baad mein wapas laana bohat mushkil hai. Agar mudna mutawaqqa tarah barhe na, to surgical team ko jaldi batayein, kyunke woh zyada dard par qaboo, zyada shadeed therapy ya anaesthesia ke neeche manipulation ka mashwara de sakte hain.

beats.patient: A 66-year-old woman, ten days after a right total knee replacement, can walk with a frame, has full extension but bends to only 70 degrees. The knee is warm but not red, she has no fever and is doing her exercises only twice a day.
beats.assessment: The bend is behind the usual target, and there are no signs of infection; pain and swelling may be limiting her.
beats.treatment: Take pain relief before sessions, increase heel slides and cycling to short, frequent bouts, control swelling with elevation and ice, and recheck in a few days; tell the surgical team if bending does not improve.
beats.reassess: Within a week the bend reaches 95 degrees and she walks with a stick.

text.en: **Contact the surgical team urgently** for a hot, red, swollen knee with fever or a leaking wound, a hot, tender, swollen calf, chest pain or sudden breathlessness (possible pulmonary embolism, emergency), a sudden loss of the ability to bear weight, a knee that suddenly gives way or looks deformed, or numbness or a cold, pale foot.
text.ur: **Surgical team ko foran batayein** garam, surkh, soojha hua knee bukhar ya zakhm se pani ke saath, garam, dardnak, soojhi hui pindli, seene ka dard ya achanak saans ki tangi (mumkin pulmonary embolism, emergency), achanak wazan na utha pana, knee ka achanak jawab dena ya bad-shakli, ya sunn hona ya thanda zard pair.

summary.en: Start rehab on day zero or one: control swelling, regain full extension and 90 degrees of bend by about two weeks, and wake up the quadriceps.
summary.ur: Rehab day zero ya ek par shuru karein: sujan par qaboo, poori extension aur takreeban do haftay mein 90 degree mudna, aur quadriceps ko jagana.

summary.en: Build strength over at least three months with sit-to-stand, step-ups, bridging and cycling, and review at six and twelve weeks.
summary.ur: Kam az kam teen mahine sit-to-stand, step-ups, bridging aur cycling se taaqat banayein, aur chhe aur barah haftay par review karein.

summary.en: Know the warning signs: a hot red knee with fever, a hot tender calf and chest pain or breathlessness all need urgent medical help.
summary.ur: Warning signs jaanein: bukhar ke saath garam surkh knee, garam dardnak pindli aur seene ka dard ya saans ki tangi sab ko foran medical madad chahiye.
